short_description: Shipped `education` variable is wrong scale/variable vs published Table 2 (1-8 ordinal incompatible with published coef 0.00002)
rationale: Coding error impacting an IV; impacts estimation.

short_description: 14 sentinel values (-3105) in `education`; published N (15419) implies the published run had no education missingness
rationale: Data irregularity impacting an IV (sentinel values); Brodeur standard explicitly covers data irregularities.

short_description: `education` and `lucid_education` identical; package lacks any variable that could reproduce published cols 3-4
rationale: Package-completeness evidence supporting issue 1; not a distinct coding/specification/merge error.

short_description: Shipped tables/_Table02.tex disagrees with the published Table 2
rationale: Packaging/version inconsistency (evidence of issue 1), not itself a variable, model, or merge error.

short_description: dplyr::recode of DV emits unreplaced-values-to-NA warnings; categories exhaustive here
rationale: Latent risk; report itself says not an error in this data.

short_description: `NewArrest` (arrest-rate IV) constructed inverted: asinh(attacks/(arrests+1)) instead of arrests/attacks as defined in Methods
rationale: IV construction error; reverses headline.

short_description: Charge rate logically impossible (charges > arrests in 55 country-years; ratio up to 17)
rationale: Data irregularity impacting the charge-rate IV.

short_description: Applied transform is not the IHS stated in Methods (asinh(1+x)-like, nonzero at 0)
rationale: Transform error impacting analysis variables.

short_description: Two conflicting sentence variables; `SentenceSin` derives from `sentence` not `length`; paper describes 'average number of years'
rationale: Data irregularity impacting the sentence IV; that coefficient is the one that fails to reproduce.

short_description: DV is per 10,000 population; paper states per 100,000
rationale: DV units error.

short_description: No analysis code shipped (plotting script only) despite code-availability statement
rationale: Availability/packaging failure; not a coding, specification, or merge error.

short_description: Published Figure 4 x-axis category order differs from shipped factor levels
rationale: Cosmetic/presentation; values identical.

short_description: mutate() arrow-assignment bug creates junk columns; intended recomputation of alignment variables silently dropped; raw columns used downstream
rationale: Not counted as major: Genuine coding error, but verified to leave analysis variables holding intended values; no theoretical path to impacting claims demonstrated.

short_description: GMO belief outcome non-missing for only 52 respondents
rationale: Verified data feature, not an error.

short_description: Tables code restricts Panel A col 6 to `if any_time==1` (N=107749); published col 6 is full sample (N=210586)
rationale: Coding error (wrong sample filter) impacting the published estimates.

short_description: Income variables used by tables code (hhinc1-hhinc6) do not exist in the cleaned data; published table built on the income coding the I4R review flagged as erroneous
rationale: Coding error in analysis covariates; published table rests on erroneous coding.

short_description: Corrected 02_cleaning.do uses seven income variables and two others it never creates; file cannot execute
rationale: Script breakage in the package (post-publication corrected file); not a defect in the published analysis's variables, model, or merges.

short_description: `somcol` mixes respondent education (peeduca) with partner education (parteduc) in one condition
rationale: Coding error impacting an IV; could in theory impact estimation (impact low for assigned panel).

short_description: `any_waiting` uses `> 0` test that would capture Stata missings
rationale: Latent bug; no missing values exist, so no error is realized (verified in report).

short_description: IHST columns scale note vs code (USD-scaled inputs)
rationale: Report codes this as a transparency note, explicitly 'not an error'.

short_description: DD codes 1921 as treated; text describes 'period after 1921' and event study uses 1921 as reference year
rationale: Not counted as major: Treatment-variable coding vs text; could in theory impact claims, but report deems coding defensible and robustness shows stability.

short_description: Quota exposure group means vary slightly across post years
rationale: Verified as unbalanced-panel artifact; report: 'not an error'.

short_description: 'catagory' misspelling in file/variable names
rationale: Cosmetic.

short_description: Data file carries 1900-1940 but DV non-missing only 1900-1937
rationale: Verified consistent with stated window; no spurious rows enter the regression.

short_description: Cols 5-6 N drop matches paper footnote
rationale: Confirms the paper; not an error.

short_description: Quarterly dummies omitted from IV columns although paper states all regressions include them; adding them moves Reform coef -0.123 to -0.170 (+38%)
rationale: Specification/coding error; moves assigned coefficient 38%.

short_description: Hard-coded absolute Windows path; referenced raw file not shipped
rationale: Portability/packaging; no effect on estimates.

short_description: Sample-flag inconsistency: col 2/6 use sample1, LSDV cols use pre-existing `sample`, within-IV cols rely on earlier keep
rationale: Not counted as major: Filter irregularity across columns; no demonstrated impact on any estimate.

short_description: `dist` defined only for the 2013 treated window, 0 for controls
rationale: Design oddity; coefficient tiny, no impact per report.

short_description: Analysis code reads CSV files that do not exist in the package
rationale: Packaging failure; reproduction possible via the shipped .sav.

short_description: `age` stored as brackets (2-6) but paper reports years (18-76, M=44.79)
rationale: Not counted as major: Data irregularity, but affects reported sample descriptives, not the claims tested.

short_description: Multiple overlapping condition/outcome variables, no codebook
rationale: Documentation deficiency.

short_description: Published Table 1 note describes the Male dummy backwards (says 'female')
rationale: Not counted as major: Transcription-type error (published note inverts the IV definition); estimates and in-text interpretation correct.

short_description: `Cutoff_cumsum_biddinground` dead-code bug: evaluates to 0 for every row
rationale: Dead code; variable unused, cannot impact claims.

short_description: Prior-cutoffs count uses actual leader while DV uses perceived leader
rationale: Report codes as defensible design choice, 'not an error'.

short_description: Published 5% star on col-3 TC not reproducible under the package's own stated wild-bootstrap procedure (p~0.051-0.063); matches asymptotic t instead
rationale: Transcription/post-regression error: printed significance star contradicts the stated procedure and impacts a tested claim (Brodeur taxonomy dimension iii).

short_description: boottest p-values seed/stream-dependent at the 0.05 boundary
rationale: Methodological fragility, not an error.

short_description: outreg2 asymptotic stars differ from printed bootstrap stars in cols 1-2 (correctly overridden) and col 3 (not)
rationale: Subsumed by issue 1; reporting-pipeline observation.

short_description: Table A6 outreg2 exports variables that are not regressors in those models
rationale: Not counted as major: Coding error in appendix-table export; affects non-assigned exhibit.

short_description: README refers to a differently named do-file
rationale: Cosmetic.

short_description: Three stated control variables are time-invariant per station and silently dropped by the FE estimator in every Figure 2 regression
rationale: Not counted as major: Stated controls mechanically dropped; estimates unchanged, claims unaffected.

short_description: Sample filter deletes 0 observations
rationale: Non-binding restriction; harmless.

short_description: Footnote-28 competitor-count adjustment applied to the subsample selector but not the covariate
rationale: Cannot establish from the paper whether the covariate was also meant to be adjusted; flagged as ambiguity, not an established error.

short_description: Hard-coded week-count fix for station id 126
rationale: Fragile manual patch in the build; not used in Figure 2.

short_description: Treatment varies at province level (8 clusters) but SEs clustered at station level
rationale: Design/inference critique, not a coding error.
